takes.title: Walk Forward at a Brisk Pace
takes.actionDescription: After one arms-out frame, the performer moves into brisk forward steps with a pronounced arm swing and finishes in stride. The source jumps between the opening pose and the walk.
takes.reviewNote: Captured frame 1 has all-zero channels. Frame 2 (0.0083 s) is the first moving pose and follows a 2.246 m horizontal root discontinuity. The first usable frame is recorded for later review.
